badgeHint.message: The download continues in the background: it goes on even if you reload or close the page. Follow it on the toolbar icon (green percentage).

popupRecommendedEmpty.message: No featured video on this page; see "Other".

popupEmpty.message: No video found in this tab.

popupDebugTitle.message: Copies technical details for a bug report to the clipboard

noteSeparateAudio.message: Audio comes as a separate file

siteNoteReload.message: $1: the extension was loaded after this tab was opened. Reload the page (⌘R) for complete files, then open the popup again.

siteNoteNoEntries.message: $1: no complete file data on this page, only raw pieces are listed. Try opening the post and reloading the page.

noteBlob.message: Segmented stream; see the HLS/DASH entry caught from the network

noteQuickTime.message: $1: QuickTime will not open it, play it in VLC

popupDebugCopied.message: Debug info copied to the clipboard.

popupDebugSelect.message: No clipboard access; the text is selected below, copy it.

optUiLanguageHint.message: English and Turkish are available; with "Chrome's language" any other language shows English.

optMergeTracks.message: Merge separately downloaded video and audio into one MP4

optMergeTracksHint.message: Reddit and some HLS streams serve video and audio separately. When off, two files arrive (-video.mp4, -audio.m4a).

optPreferH264.message: Prefer the H.264 quality (DASH and HLS)

optPreferH264Hint.message: Sites like Instagram serve the same video as VP9 and H.264, some film players give the top quality as AV1; H.264 opens in QuickTime without converting. AV1/HEVC/VP9 qualities are named in the quality menu.

optTranscode.message: Convert non-H.264 video (VP9, AV1) to H.264

optTranscodeHint.message: QuickTime does not play VP9/AV1; converting happens in the browser and can take minutes for long videos. When on, plain video files are downloaded by the extension instead of Chrome too, and converted when needed.

optConcurrency.message: Pieces downloaded at the same time

optConcurrencyHint.message: 1–8. Lower it for slow servers, raise it for fast CDNs.

optStripJunk.message: Remove junk bytes at the start of pieces

optStripJunkHint.message: Some hosts put non-video bytes in front of segments; when on, everything up to the first valid TS/MP4 data is dropped.

optCooldown.message: Longest wait on a rate limit (minutes)

optCooldownHint.message: When a server says "too many requests" (429), the job first spaces its requests, then waits and continues until this budget is used. 0: no long waits, the job fails at once.

optAudioHint.message: When a stream has several audio languages (for example a dub and the original), the in-page button and the shortcut take this one; the popup's audio menu opens on it. Original: a track named "Original", else the first one that is not Turkish. If the site's buttons open a separate player (one audio track), pick that option on the site first.

optSubtitleLangsHint.message: Language codes, comma separated (tr, en); the order is the priority. * all languages, empty none. The in-page button and the shortcut take these; the popup ticks them in advance.

optEmbedSubtitlesHint.message: The subtitles do not arrive as separate files and are picked from the subtitle menu in QuickTime and VLC. Plain video files with subtitles chosen are downloaded by the extension too and become one MP4.

optHideAdsHint.message: Banner-sized (728×90, 300×250 …), very short and small, or ad-server videos are taken out of the recommended list; they stay in "Other" and in the "All" view.

optBadgeHover.message: While the pointer is over the video

optBadgeHint.message: A small "Download" button at the video's top-left corner; ad videos get none.

optBadgeHosts.message: Sites where the button is hidden

optBadgeHostsHint.message: One domain per line; subdomains are included (instagram.com → www.instagram.com).

optTemplateHint.message: Available fields: {site} {title} {date} {time} {quality} {id}. Empty fields and their separators are skipped.

optShortcutHint.message: Default Alt+Shift+D: downloads the best video of the open tab. To change it: chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

progressQueuedDetail.message: Starts when a running download ends

jobResumable.message: Download it again to continue where it stopped

notifyDoneHint.message: Click to show it in its folder

optMaxJobsHint.message: Further downloads wait in the queue ("Queued") and start when one ends. Plain video files are downloaded by Chrome itself and do not wait.

optNotifyHint.message: A system notification when an HLS/DASH download is done or has failed; clicking it shows the file.

optSubfolderHint.message: Empty: Downloads itself. Fields: {site} {date}; / makes subfolders, e.g. VideoDownloader/{site}.
